source: Anthropic Claude API and Claude Code Enterprise
method: scripts/fetch-claude-api-catalog.mjs (2026-09-25): models[] from the server-rendered model and batch price tables on https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing; rows labelled retired there, or Retired in the lifecycle table on https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations, are excluded; lifecycle_status and tentative retirement dates come from that table by API model id. Pricing modifiers are derived from the current tables and text. Claude Code Enterprise seat pricing comes from https://claude.com/pricing; seat minimums, usage billing, limits, and legacy-plan terms come from https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9797531-what-is-the-enterprise-plan. See claude-code.method.md.

claude_code_enterprise.usage_billing: Usage is billed separately at standard API rates based on actual team consumption.
claude_code_enterprise.usage_limits: Usage-based Enterprise plans have no plan or seat-level usage limits; administrators can set spend limits.
claude_code_enterprise.sales_assisted_options: Invoicing, multi-currency billing, and HIPAA-readiness/BAA are available through sales.
claude_code_enterprise.legacy_note: Some organizations remain on older seat-based Enterprise plans with Standard and Premium seats and per-seat limits until they migrate to usage-based billing.

pricing_modifiers.us_only_inference_applies_to: Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and later models; global routing is standard price.

plan_notes: The direct API list prices in models[] are the token rates used by current Claude Code Enterprise usage billing. Enterprise adds a $20/user/month access seat billed annually; the seat includes Claude Code but no token allowance. Enterprise volume discounts and custom terms may be negotiated through sales. Claude Sonnet 5 $2/$10 is now the permanent standard price; the previously scheduled increase was cancelled. Output tokens, including thinking tokens, use the single output rate.
